answer: Every claim climbs the orchard of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the prism re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lagoon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
